authorization: BRANCHING 12 cycles followed by 20 adaptive cycles
method: AB3.2.1; sequential conditional selection after observed evidence; caps not quotas
decision_at_start: Congress catalogue is independently listed and exposes download links in public HTML, but old dated JSON endpoints failed web fetch. Validate real network, no assumptions about persons.

hypotheses.H1: GitHub Actions verified-TLS fetch can retrieve fresh canonical catalogue and at least one machine-readable dataset
hypotheses.H0: Catalogue or assets inaccessible or malformed; no usable real person rows

instrument: Python bounded HTML-link discovery and SHA256 raw capture; network CI, strict host, maximum bytes, no values printed.
criteria: H1 if at least one retrieved file validates basic format; otherwise STOP_R5, and next cycle must pivot to alternative official source or diagnose accessible metadata.
